observable_symptom: Family resemblance is carried disproportionately by oversized light Chinese title treatment, brush/calligraphic surface behavior, dark rustic mountain-kitchen imagery, repeated wok/action mass and familiar accent/mountain tokens.
Structural display-mass behavior is not independently demonstrated from its surface styling.
what_this_evidence_does_prove: The current V1 wording and Attempt-1 payloads allow a repeated surface-token bundle to satisfy apparent family resemblance.
Texture and brush-like styling cannot be accepted as proof of structural authored display mass.
what_this_evidence_does_not_prove: It does not prove that every listed surface token is always invalid or aesthetically poor.
It does not prove that the VPD architecture as a whole failed.
It does not isolate whether Capsule wording, payload compilation or generator priors contributed most.
failure_modes.corrective_requirement: Separate structural display-mass topology from optional surface treatment and encode the repeated token bundle as non-sufficient family evidence and anti-shortcut exclusions.
failure_modes.retest_requirement: A later controlled FAMILY test must change several surface tokens while preserving and explicitly explaining the deeper title/photo/hierarchy mechanisms.

observable_symptom: F1 introduced active cooking/wok action even though the conservative tier was intended to isolate typography and copy rebinding in an environmental dining/interior field.
F1 and F2 converged strongly enough in content and layout that F2's process operators cannot be cleanly attributed.
what_this_evidence_does_prove: Attempt 1 cannot support clean causal attribution between the conservative and subject/process tiers.
A future experiment needs machine-readable held constants, changed variables and prohibited leakage per tier.
what_this_evidence_does_not_prove: It does not prove that CONTENT_SWAP or TYPOGRAPHY_REBIND is impossible.
It does not establish a durable failure of the underlying mechanism because the variables were contaminated.
failure_modes.corrective_requirement: Introduce an explicit operator-isolation contract that automatically fails when a later tier's defining content leaks into an earlier tier.
failure_modes.retest_requirement: Retest with F1 excluding hand, wok, flame and active stir-fry; introduce active cooking only in F2; hold F2 content/process state fixed before changing aspect in F3.

observable_symptom: F2 and F3 resolve toward familiar large brush-title, dark kitchen, wok/action and mountain-associated restaurant-poster formulas.
F1/F2 positional differentiation is insufficient and F3 uses a generic tall restaurant-poster fallback.
what_this_evidence_does_prove: Current family similarity can be explained too easily through a generic domain template rather than the claimed causal relationships.
Relational topology and mechanism-explanation sufficiency are missing from the controlled pass criteria.
what_this_evidence_does_not_prove: It does not prove that all Chinese restaurant posters or all brush lettering are generic.
It does not prove that stronger photography is irrelevant; F2's realism remains useful partial evidence.
It does not authorize global taste rules against a cultural or typographic category.
failure_modes.corrective_requirement: Encode location-free relational topology, non-sufficient surface tokens and a requirement that family similarity be explainable by mechanisms rather than palette, brush font, mountain, wok or repeated composition.
failure_modes.retest_requirement: Require meaningful divergence in title geometry/location, photo-mass location, accent/motif presence, color family, depth staging and layout topology while preserving deeper relationships.

observable_symptom: F3 achieved a 941x1672 tall bitmap but did not demonstrate structural reallocation of title, photo and support zones.
The composition fell back to a generic vertical formula and introduced an unnecessary mountain-line token to occupy or organize the tall frame.
what_this_evidence_does_prove: A technically tall output is not sufficient evidence of ASPECT_ADAPT.
The current ASPECT_ADAPT instruction does not prevent center-stacked/giant-calligraphy fallback or unjustified filler motifs strongly enough for causal validation.
what_this_evidence_does_not_prove: It does not prove that 9:16 adaptation is impossible.
It does not prove that the original coordinates should be retained.
It does not isolate stochastic generator variation from the under-specified operator contract.
failure_modes.corrective_requirement: Define ASPECT_ADAPT as aspect-dependent zone reallocation and reading-order graph preservation, with explicit failure conditions for generic vertical fallback, filler tokens and stretch/stack-only adaptation.
failure_modes.retest_requirement: Hold the F2 process/content state constant, change only aspect/density variables, and require evidence of native zone reflow without new decorative filler.

cross_failure_inference_boundary.reason: Attempt 1 is a bounded negative sample of Capsule V1 plus its controlled experiment; it identifies local formalization and isolation gaps but cannot support a global compiler conclusion.
